# RenderSettings

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/render_settings.h`](../../../src/logic/components/render_settings.h)

## Summary

Runtime toggles of the scene passes and the grass shader parameters.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced by the Renderer constructor; DebugMenuSys edits it; TerrainPass, GrassPass and ModelPass read it (find) to skip drawing and to fill the grass parameters.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `terrain` | `bool` | true | draw TerrainPass |
| `grass` | `bool` | true | draw GrassPass |
| `models` | `bool` | true | draw ModelPass |
| `grass_params.base_normal` | `glm::vec4` | (0, 1, 0, 0) | grass shell base normal |
| `grass_params.tile_size` | `float` | 1 | grass tile size |
| `grass_params.height` | `float` | 1 | grass height |
| `grass_params.noise_frequency` | `float` | 0.0001 | grass noise frequency |
| `grass_params.noise_amplitude` | `float` | 0.1 | grass noise amplitude |

## Systems touching this component

- **Writers:** [DebugMenuSys](../systems/DebugMenuSys.md), [Renderer](../systems/Renderer.md)
- **Readers:** [DebugMenuSys](../systems/DebugMenuSys.md), [GrassPass](../systems/GrassPass.md), [ModelPass](../systems/ModelPass.md), [TerrainPass](../systems/TerrainPass.md)
- **Creates / emplaces:** [Renderer](../systems/Renderer.md)
- **Destroys / removes:** None

| System | Kind | Registry | Access | Phase | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [DebugMenuSys](../systems/DebugMenuSys.md) | system | host | `readwrite` | tick | Checkboxes terrain/grass/models; sliders on grass_params tile_size, height, base_normal.xyz, noise_frequency, noise_amplitude. |
| [GrassPass](../systems/GrassPass.md) | pass | host | `read` | record | find; requires it present and grass == true; grass_params (base_normal, tile_size, height, noise_frequency, noise_amplitude) become push constants. |
| [ModelPass](../systems/ModelPass.md) | pass | host | `read` | record | find; models == false skips the pass (draws when absent). |
| [Renderer](../systems/Renderer.md) | service | host | `write` +emplace_ctx | construction | Default-constructed (all passes on). |
| [TerrainPass](../systems/TerrainPass.md) | pass | host | `read` | record | find; terrain == false skips the pass (draws when absent). |

## Side effects per system

None recorded beyond the field accesses above.
